building_method: Rasterize mapped building footprints at 5m and aggregate to approximate percentage coverage of 30m cells.
density_method: Mean 30m building footprint fraction within a circular 300m neighbourhood, restricted to sampled study-area cells.
scientific_limitations: OSM 2026 footprints are not historical 2018 building observations.
OSM building completeness is not independently verified.
Building footprint coverage is a proxy for development intensity, not measured impervious surface.
The 5m rasterization is numerical area approximation, not 5m source mapping accuracy.
Near the study boundary, neighbourhood density considers only sampled Kaduwela cells, not the full external neighbourhood.
Road classes are inventoried only; no road susceptibility factor is created.
Urban density may correlate strongly with existing built-up land cover.
No susceptibility weights, ML labels or predictions are produced.
